ajay: Quick RFC follow-up: ops/eval need a minimal telemetry + fallback contract for FP8/INT8/4-bit. What do we emit at 100% vs sampled?
katie: 100% fields: precision_profile_id (GUID), precision_profile_label, model@version, degradation_score (aggregate), mean_token_confidence, batching_latency_ms, gpu_mem_pct, prompt_fp (sha256). Low cardinality only.
sophia: Per-layer arrays are expensive. Proposal: sample 1% for per_layer_mean_abs and per_layer_max_abs. Always include sample_rate when sampled. All requests get mean_abs_delta and top_k_mismatch_rate.
mike: Runtime vs control plane: control plane owns rollouts/canaries. Runtime can do emergency fallback only when control_plane_unreachable AND infra_pressure AND quality_safe. Must log reason_code and metric_snapshot.
ajay: Define infra_pressure = (gpu_mem_pct > 92 OR p95_latency > 2xSLO). quality_safe = (degradation_score < 0.02). Require two consecutive windows before runtime acts.
katie: Canary plan: start 0.5% traffic with shadow per-layer sampling for canary requests. Auto-rollback rules: median degradation_score > 0.04 for 5m OR top_k_mismatch_rate spike > 0.02. Promotion above 5% requires human approval.
sophia: Add tokens_saved_pct and cost_delta_usd to telemetry so gating can be multi-dimensional (quality vs cost). Also include immutable fallback_profile_id on profiles.
mike: Privacy/retention: never emit raw prompt. Emit prompt_fp and prompt_redacted boolean. Default retention 30d; enterprise opt-in up to 90d with compliance review.
quant-bot: "RFC follow-up noted: minimal telemetry schema + sampled per-layer, hybrid fallback FSM, canary thresholds. Action items: @sophia PR FSM, @ajay publish schema, @mike draft canary playbook, @katie update retention policy. :white_check_mark:"
